Working tool · English and Arabic

Numbers to words converter

Type an amount and pick a currency. The amount is written out in English and Arabic, ready to copy into a cheque, bill of exchange or letter.

Runs entirely in your browser. Nothing you type is sent anywhere. Amounts are never rounded: an entry with more decimals than the currency allows is rejected with a message instead.
